title: Cohort Retention
note: Computed by checks_dashboards_demo.py from the frozen .psv rows, with the same definitions truths.out uses. Each value carries the SQL it came from; Phase B2 holds every widget to these numbers.

kpis.label: Average 6-month retention
kpis.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.order_ts >= c.signup_date + INTERVAL 5 MONTH AND o.order_ts < c.signup_date + INTERVAL 7 MONTH) THEN 1 END) / count(*), 2) FROM dash_demo.customers c WHERE c.signup_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND c.signup_date < DATE '2026-04-01'

kpis.label: Cohorts on the heatmap
kpis.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT date_trunc('month', c.signup_date)) FROM dash_demo.customers c WHERE true

density.sql: SELECT min(n) FROM (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM dash_demo.customers c WHERE true AND c.signup_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' GROUP BY date_trunc('month', c.signup_date))
